name: Sara
source:
A mysterious woman that give protagonist his new camera. Is little weird and seems to lack some common sense.

[spoiler] She's from the future and one of protagonist descendants. Claiming that she is extra horny because they share same genes. She heard how kind he was and wanted to meet him. The camera is adult toy from future that only works on people that like/love each other. It stops working on random people when protagonist falls in love. [/spoiler]
